notes.title: 3.5 Update
notes.content:
-New Tour System
-New Amulet interface for Menu and Tours
-New artworks added to The Main Hall and The Vault
-Bunch of bugs fixed
-New song added to Diorama-Rama

notes.title: 3.0 Update
notes.content:
The Vault: a new universe
Over 90 new artworks, including new video interfaces and homemade NFTs to help the development of The OmniGallery.
Minor bug fixes and improved interfaces.

Stay tuned on IG @eternalechoesvr for new universes and updates in the future!

notes.title: 2.5 Update
notes.content:
The new update includes:
-A new 3D information interface, aimed at VR interactions. (still available for 2D PC users).
-The Main Hall now has a Credit section for the information on all aspects of The OmniGallery.
-Dozens of bugs fixed 

Please email me at EternalEchoesvr@gmail.com if you encounter any problems, bugs or any feedback you might have. 
Enjoy!
